blocks.text: 1. Embedding Evaluation
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162015-984437053.png
Embedding Evaluation gives the evaluation step promised in fine tuning its own full treatment: how to systematically measure embedding quality.
It turns a vague sense of quality into concrete, measurable numbers.
2. Why Intuition Isn't Enough
As with evaluating the fine tuned model in Embedding Fine-Tuning, eyeballing a handful of search results does not reliably reveal whether an embedding model is good.
Systematic evaluation replaces that intuition with repeatable measurement.
3. Building An Evaluation Set
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162015-229383737.png
As with building training pairs in Embedding Fine-Tuning, a labeled set of queries and their known correct chunks forms the evaluation foundation.
That labeled set stays separate from any data used to fine tune the model.
4. Precision And Recall For Embeddings
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162016-16154737.png
Precision measures how many retrieved chunks were actually relevant.
Recall measures how many of the relevant chunks actually got retrieved at all.

blocks.content: {"headers":["Metric","Question it answers"],"rows":[["Precision","Of what was retrieved, how much was actually relevant"],["Recall","Of what was actually relevant, how much was retrieved"]]}

blocks.text: 5. Ranking Aware Metrics
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162183-763243674.png
A relevant chunk buried at position fifty helps far less than one ranked first.
Ranking aware metrics reward correct results that appear near the top.

blocks.title: info
blocks.content: Two systems retrieving the exact same correct chunk can score very differently on a ranking aware metric depending on whether that chunk appeared first or was buried far down the results list.

blocks.text: 6. Comparing Models Head To Head
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162184-403079942.png
As with benchmarking embedding models in Embedding Models, running the same evaluation set through two models produces a direct comparison.
The higher scoring model wins on that specific evaluation set.
7. Evaluating On Real Queries Not Just Benchmarks

blocks.alt: Evaluating On Real Queries Not Just Benchmarks
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162185-530582445.png
As with benchmarking embedding models in Embedding Models, public benchmark scores may not reflect a specific pipeline's actual queries.
Building a custom evaluation set from real, representative queries gives far more trustworthy results.

blocks.title: warn
blocks.content: A model that tops a public benchmark leaderboard can still perform worse than a lower ranked model on a specific pipeline's own real queries, since the benchmark data does not necessarily resemble that pipeline's actual content.

blocks.text: 8. Continuous Evaluation Over Time
As with embedding drift, the subject of the next topic in this module, a model that performed well initially can degrade in effectiveness as content changes.
Re-running evaluation periodically catches that kind of quiet, gradual decline.

blocks.text: 9. Recognizing When Embedding Evaluation Deserves Dedicated Investment

blocks.alt: Recognizing When Embedding Evaluation Deserves Dedicated Investment
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447162185-985356583.png
Production systems making real retrieval decisions need rigorous evaluation.
Early exploratory prototypes can rely on lighter, more informal checks initially.
10. Worked Example
The example below demonstrates computing precision and recall for a set of retrieved chunks against known relevant chunks.

code.content:
evaluation_set = [
    {
        "query": "how to reset a password",
        "relevant_chunks": {"chunk_5", "chunk_12"},
        "retrieved_chunks": ["chunk_5", "chunk_9", "chunk_12", "chunk_20"],
    },
]

def compute_precision_recall(relevant, retrieved):
    # precision: relevant among retrieved; recall: retrieved among relevant
    retrieved_set = set(retrieved)
    true_positives = relevant & retrieved_set
    precision = len(true_positives) / len(retrieved_set) if retrieved_set else 0
    recall = len(true_positives) / len(relevant) if relevant else 0
    return precision, recall

for item in evaluation_set:
    precision, recall = compute_precision_recall(item["relevant_chunks"], item["retrieved_chunks"])
    print(f"Query: {item['query']!r}")
    print(f"  retrieved: {item['retrieved_chunks']}")
    print(f"  relevant: {item['relevant_chunks']}")
    print(f"  precision={precision:.2f}, recall={recall:.2f}")

blocks.title: info
blocks.content: Running this example shows precision reflecting that only two of the four retrieved chunks were actually relevant, while recall reflects that both known relevant chunks were successfully retrieved.

blocks.text: 11. Common Mistakes

items: Judging embedding quality from a handful of manually eyeballed queries instead of a systematic evaluation set.
Using training data for evaluation instead of keeping a separate labeled evaluation set.
Trusting public benchmark rankings alone without testing on real, representative queries.
Evaluating a model once at launch and never re-checking it as content and usage evolve.

blocks.text: 12. Key Takeaways

items: Embedding evaluation turns a vague sense of quality into concrete, measurable numbers.
Systematic evaluation replaces unreliable intuition with repeatable measurement.
A labeled evaluation set of queries and known correct chunks forms the evaluation foundation.
Precision measures relevance among retrieved results; recall measures completeness of retrieval.
Ranking aware metrics reward correct results that appear near the top of the results.
Running the same evaluation set through two models produces a direct, fair comparison.
Public benchmarks may not reflect a specific pipeline's actual queries; custom evaluation sets do.
Periodic re-evaluation catches gradual quality decline that a one time check would miss.
Next up: Embedding Drift, covering why embedding quality can degrade over time even without changes.
